Implemented the Node.js CLI simulator under [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js) with supporting modules in [output/simulator.js](/workspace/output/simulator.js), [output/parser.js](/workspace/output/parser.js), [output/geometry.js](/workspace/output/geometry.js), [output/utils.js](/workspace/output/utils.js), and [output/errors.js](/workspace/output/errors.js). It accepts the required flags, reads RS274 parameter/tool files, executes G-code into machine state, writes the required JSON result payload, and emits trace JSON with stepped motion samples.

I verified the executable path with targeted runs covering linear feed motion, dwell, parameter buffering, canned-cycle expansion, and an error case (`G43 H99`) with the expected exit code behavior. You can run it as:
```bash
node output/main.js --input program.ngc --output result.json
```
